about_the_game:
*Special note: "The Three Kingdoms:Rebirth" is a live action interactive film game that travels through the Three Kingdoms theme. It is an adventure journey in parallel time and space, and does not involve the original work or historical facts.

Peach blossoms never disappoint, hegemony never fails ", let's embark on a romantic journey through the world to protect and strategize for hegemony!

The dual perfect experience of "peach blossom" and "dominance" that I desire

As a time traveler, you don't have to make painful choices between "dating" and "conquering the world". The game provides a sophisticated system that allows your emotional investment to receive the expected returns (such as Zhen Mi's wealth, Cai Zhaoji's wisdom, and Da Qiao's prophecy), and your successful dominance can better protect your loved ones. Farewell is difficult to calm down, harvest a fulfilling life!

The thrill of breaking through the game of "modern thinking" with a strong sense of immersion

As a time traveler, it comes with the aura of the protagonist. Your modern values, knowledge, and sense of humor will become your unique weapon to break through the Three Kingdoms dilemma and win the favor of beautiful women. Experience the thrill of "dimensionality reduction strike", a future "shareholding system" plan can successfully convince Zhen Mi to invest.

Every choice is full of weight and resonance

Your choice not only affects favorability, but also directly adapts the historical direction of the game world, character fate, and even the final outcome. Your decisions are truly weighty, and you can see tangible feedback (such as special plot, character loyalty, and power enhancement), gaining a strong sense of control and achievement.

Growing together with a flesh and blood 'soulmate'

You are not only encountering the top-notch "Goddess of Illusion" in terms of appearance, but also partners with independent thinking, career, and aspirations. The relationship with them is a strong alliance between adults, a two-way rush. You can experience mutual growth, mutual achievement, and deep emotional connection.

Multi playtime value and exploration fun

Dozens of different endings and vast branching routes mean that each choice is a different journey. Explore countless possibilities on the other side, enjoy discovering hidden storylines and achieving rare achievements.

'Peach blossoms never fail, dominance never fails', the dual main storyline runs through the entire game, achieving a fun gaming experience

Peach blossoms do not disappoint - emotional immersion

Multi dimensional favorability system: Each character has unique preferences and strategies

Deep character plot: Each female lead has her own personal storyline, revealing her unknown past and secrets

Dynamic Relationship Network: Characters will interact, be jealous, and form alliances. The relationship network is really complex

Modern romantic interaction: the modern roast/playing with stalks/and flirting style brought by the passers-by have a unique experience.

Striving for dominance - Strategic challenge line

United Front and Horizontal Front: Interacting with forces such as Cao Cao, Sun Quan, Liu Bei, etc., maneuvering and participating in famous historical events

Stone transportation collection: The power to change the game world through stone transportation collection

Hardcore Challenge: Dealing with various game challenges and making cruel and necessary strategic decisions.
